create_AmbientLighting: create an AmbientLighting module with custom intensity and color for soft rendering
create_DirectionalLighting: create a DirectionalLighting module with specified intensity, color, and direction for soft rendering
create_Lighting_surface_mode: create a Lighting module in surface mode to apply ambient and directional lighting to mesh faces
create_Lighting_vertex_mode: create a Lighting module in vertex mode to apply ambient and directional lighting to mesh vertices
review_Lighting_forward: review the Lighting forward method to understand how surface and vertex lighting modes modify mesh textures
